description: Event creation requests to the Klaviyo events API, in JSON:API shape.

params.name: data.type
params.description: JSON:API resource type, which Klaviyo documents as `event` for this endpoint.

params.name: data.attributes.metric.data.type
params.description: The nested metric resource is typed `metric`. Klaviyo documents `type` as required on the metric object.

params.name: data.attributes.metric.data.attributes.name
params.description: It is the name of the metric the event is recorded against. Klaviyo documents fewer than 128 characters.
params.fix_hint: Name the metric, such as `Placed Order`, in at most 128 characters.

params.name: data.attributes.properties
params.description: Klaviyo documents `properties` as required on the event attributes object. An empty object is allowed when there are no custom properties.
params.fix_hint: Send a `properties` object. Use `{}` when there are no custom properties.

params.name: data.attributes.time
params.description: It is when the event occurred. Klaviyo documents an ISO 8601 datetime and defaults to request time when it is omitted.
params.fix_hint: Send an ISO 8601 timestamp, such as `2022-11-08T00:00:00+00:00`.

params.name: data.attributes.value
params.description: It is a numeric monetary value for the event. Klaviyo documents it together with `value_currency`.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as `9.99`, with no currency symbol.

params.name: data.attributes.value_currency
params.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency of `value`.
params.fix_hint: Use a three-letter code such as `USD`.

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.email
params.description: One of email, phone number, external id, or id identifies the profile.

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.phone_number
params.description: It is the profile phone number. Klaviyo documents E.164.

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.external_id
params.description: One of email, phone number, external id, or id identifies the profile.

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.id
params.description: One of email, phone number, external id, or id identifies the profile.

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.type
params.description: The nested profile resource is typed `profile`. Klaviyo documents `type` as required on the profile object.

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.anonymous_id
params.description: It is an anonymous profile identifier. Klaviyo documents `anonymous_id` on the event profile object.
params.fix_hint: Send `anonymous_id`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes._kx
params.description: It is Klaviyo's encrypted web-tracking exchange id, also called `exchange_id`.
params.fix_hint: Send `_kx` from Klaviyo web tracking, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.locale
params.description: It is the profile locale. Klaviyo documents an IETF BCP 47 tag like `en-US` (ISO 639 plus ISO 3166 alpha-2).

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.image
params.description: It is a URL pointing at a profile image. Klaviyo documents it as a URL.
params.fix_hint: Send an absolute image URL, or omit the field.

params.name: data.attributes.profile.data.attributes.location.ip
params.description: It is the profile IP address. Klaviyo documents `location.ip` as an IP address, unhashed.
params.fix_hint: Send the raw IP in `location.ip`, not a digest.

params.name: data.attributes.unique_id
params.description: Klaviyo deduplicates on it, so a retried request is not counted twice.

rules.message: The event carries no profile identifier. Klaviyo documents at least one of id, email, phone number, or external id as required.
The event sends `value` without `value_currency`. Klaviyo documents the ISO 4217 code together with the monetary value.
The event sends `value_currency` without `value`. Klaviyo documents both together.
rules.fix_hint: Add `value` as a number, with no currency symbol.

rules.message: This field looks like a SHA-256 digest, but Klaviyo documents email and `location.ip` as unhashed.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw email address or IP. Hashing it makes the profile unmatchable.
